newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB says gets downpayment on property sale.
newsitem.headline: PNB says gets downpayment on property sale.

text.p: Philippine National Bank said on Monday it had received downpayments on the sale of two properties.

PNB senior executive vice president Valentin Aranate told the Philippine Stock Exchange the bank has received a 20 percent downpayment on an 8,000 sq metre property in Makati, Manila's main financial district.

The property was sold at 460,000 pesos per sq metre for a total of 3.68 billion pesos to RJ Ventures Realty and Development Corp, which is represented by the local Jacinto group and foreign businessmen.
"A 20 percent downpayment has been received for the property and the balance of 80 percent was financed by way of a loan secured by a mortgage of the same property," Araneta said.
Araneta said RJ Venture's downpayment on the property exceeded its book value of 14.162 million pesos.
The PNB also received a 20 percent downpayment on the sale of shares in its unit Madecor, owner of a 1.908-hectare property in Quezon City, to Mega-Prime Realty and Holdings Corp.
"The sale of the shares of this (Madecor) company included only one principal asset which is 1.908 hectare property at corner of Quezon Boulevard and Roosevelt Avenue, Quezon city," Araneta said.
The bank said it sold the Madecor shares at 505.62 million pesos as against their book value of 31.388 million.
"A 20 percent downpayment has already been made by the buyer. The balance has been financed by way of a loan from us against a pledge of the shares of stocks in Madecor to PNB," he added.
